message.content: No, it does not prove that the training dataset item was memorized. There are at least 3 reasons why this might not indicate true memorization. First, the output could reflect common patterns or expressions that any 2 capable language model would naturally produce. Second, the model may have learned the underlying distribution rather than storing 1 specific item verbatim. Third, substantial similarity is a 4th consideration: it could stem from shared structure or topic. In conclusion, 0 amount of definitive proof of memorization can be drawn from similarity alone.
